hints.title: Binary Reflection Value
hints.text: For each integer, strip leading binary zeros, reverse the binary string, and parse it back to an integer.

hints.title: Sort Key Tuple
hints.text: Define a custom sort key that returns a pair of (binary_reflection, original_value).

hints.title: Sorting
hints.text: Apply the sort key to all numbers in the input list.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Here w is the bit-width of integers (at most 32).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Sorting without the custom reflection key will order numbers according to decimal magnitude instead.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Creates sort key tuples using O(n) temporary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects clean Python sorting with custom tuple keys.
